description: Whether a coercion runs anything at all is asked of the declared type: `value` reads `string` at the interpolation and holds a `Loud` by the time it runs, because a closure wrote it and the checker kept the narrowing anyway, so the site a narrowing made look primitive runs `Loud`'s `toString` after all. The `const` stays clean, since nothing can write one.

diagnostics.message: Coercing `value` to a primitive escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the method `toString`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the method `toString` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
